newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal govt approves telecom liberalisation.
newsitem.headline: Portugal govt approves telecom liberalisation.

text.p: The Portuguese government on Thursday approved draft laws liberalising the telecommunications sector fully in 2000, ending the need for state control of Portugal Telecom and lifting restrictions on private sector activity in the defence industry.
The telecommunications law needs to be revised in time for the government to float a third tranche of Portugal Telecom, equal to some 26 percent of its stock, set for the autumn.

The government holds 51 percent and it needs to change a law barring it dropping below 50 percent before it can carry out the sale. Another law would sanction government plans to liberalise the telecommunications sector gradually until all restrictions are lifted at the end of 1999.
